## Full Implementation Existence Check: 

✅ Check A — No full implementation online:

The search turned up generic Python tower defense games (built with Pygame, not Flask), and Hawaii invasive species educational resources (curricula, reporting apps, board games) — but nothing that combines all of these elements into a Flask-based, wave-strategy game with species stats, synergies, scraping, and Pandas analysis. Your project is unique enough to proceed as-is.

✅ Check B — Cannot be fully implemented by AI:

Your project has several layers that make full AI generation unlikely or impractical:

* The species data and ecological relationships require real research and curation (web scraping from DLNR, etc.)  
* The battle/synergy logic involves your own design decisions about how species interact  
* The Flask routing \+ game state management across sessions is non-trivial  
* The Pandas analysis \+ charting tied to game history requires your own data pipeline design  
* The overall integration of all pieces into a coherent, working app is something AI can scaffold but not fully build in a working, tested state

That said, AI *can* generate partial pieces (basic Flask routes, simple battle math, etc.), so be sure to document what you use AI for — which your proposal already addresses well.

## Core Technical Requirements

**Inputs**

* Player species selection (via web form each wave)  
* Username for profile creation  
* Wave number / difficulty progression  
* (Stretch) Difficulty mode selection for procedural generation

**Outputs**

* Battle results per wave (win/loss, damage dealt/taken)  
* Score and progress display  
* End-of-run statistical charts (win rate, best species combos)  
* Educational species facts shown during gameplay  
* (Optional) Species compendium/dictionary page

**Data Types & Structures**

* Dictionaries for species stats (health, attack, resistance, synergies)  
* Lists for wave compositions, run history, and available species  
* **Classes** for Species and Wave objects  
* **Functions** for wave generation, battle calculations, score updates, synergy checks  
* CSV/JSON files for saving/loading species data and game run history

**Required Class Topics**

* **Pandas** for run history tracking and performance stats analysis  
* **Web scraping** (e.g. BeautifulSoup/requests) to pull species facts from DLNR, cached locally  
* **File I/O** for reading/writing game data (CSV/JSON)  
* **Statistical charts** (matplotlib/seaborn) for end-of-run summaries

**Flask / Web App**

* Routes for: home, game, wave resolution, results, profile, leaderboard  
* HTML templates for each major page  
* Web forms with input validation  
* Session or profile management linking scores to usernames

**Logic & Game Mechanics**

* Wave generation logic (scaling difficulty over rounds)  
* Battle calculation functions (stats-based math)  
* Resistance/synergy system (native vs. invasive combos)  
* Score tracking and updating across waves  
* (Stretch) Procedural wave generation with difficulty balancing

**Error Handling**

* Invalid or missing species selection  
* Missing/corrupted save files (CSV/JSON)  
* Failed web scrape → fallback to cached local data  
* Duplicate, empty, or invalid usernames  
* Unexpected/out-of-range stat values during battle calculations

**Software Design Outline (generated using Claude)**  
**We asked it to include classes because I understand classes and plan to use it to make it faster and easier to scale (add more species with different attributes/damage numbers/health points)**  
**We adjusted the prompt to use BeautifulSoup for webscraping and Pandas for creating the charts**  
![][image1]

Classes

Species — stores name, health, attack, resistance, and associated fun facts  
Wave — stores wave number, list of invading species, and difficulty level

Core Functions

generate\_wave(wave\_num) — builds the list of invasive species for a given wave, scaling difficulty  
calculate\_battle(native, invader) — runs the stat-based math to determine battle outcome  
check\_synergy(native\_list) — checks for native species combos that trigger defensive bonuses  
update\_score(result) — updates the player's score and progress after each wave

Data Functions

load\_species() — reads species data from CSV/JSON  
save\_run(data) — writes game run results to file  
load\_history() — loads past runs for analysis  
scrape\_species\_facts() — scrapes DLNR and caches facts locally  
analyze\_run\_history() — uses Pandas to compute win rates and best combos  
generate\_chart() — produces matplotlib charts for end-of-run summary

External Libraries

Flask \+ Jinja2 — web app and HTML templates  
Pandas — run history analysis (required class topic)  
matplotlib — statistical charts  
requests \+ BeautifulSoup4 — web scraping (required class topic)  
random / weighted logic — stretch goal procedural wave generation
